Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-22T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + proposed demo window (Aug 26/27)

Hi Anna —

Thanks again for the interest in Redwood. I wanted to lock in a 45-min demo to walk your product and security teams through a live inference run and our deployment options. Would either of the following work for your team next week?

- Wed Aug 26, 10:00–10:45 PT
- Thu Aug 27, 14:00–14:45 PT

A couple of notes from our side that might affect scheduling: your procurement team mentioned an intake and vendor questionnaire. If Horizon needs the vendor portal completed or an NDA signed before any live demo that includes system architecture or onboarding details, we can either:

1) run a high-level executive overview now (no customer data, no architecture deep-dive) to keep momentum, or
2) move the technical demo until the intake/nda are complete.

I'm looping in Monica from our onboarding team to help with the questionnaire and get you the standard security packet and SOC 2 attestation. If you can share the procurement intake link or the specific checklist, we'll start filling it out ASAP.

Attachments: Redwood_Security_Summary.pdf (summary), Redwood_Standard_NDA_link.txt

Next steps — please tell us which date you prefer and whether procurement needs the intake completed before any technical session.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for the proposed times. Procurement has confirmed that Horizon requires completion of our vendor intake form and signed NDA prior to any demo that will include technical architecture or discussions of potential integrations. I attached the intake PDF you need to return, and copied procurement to keep them in the loop.

If Redwood can sign a mutual NDA quickly and upload standard security docs (SOC2 type II report or summary, data handling policy), procurement will clear the technical demo. If you prefer to keep momentum, a 30-min executive overview (no architecture, no technical Q&A) is acceptable before the intake is complete.

We prefer to keep the technical walkthrough after intake completion to speed procurement review, so please let us know which path you prefer.

Anna
Sr. IT Procurement Manager
